This legacy began with ''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'', published less than a year after the release of ''Star Wars''.|George Lucas|<ref name="Book">''Splinter of the Mind's Eye''</ref>}}
'''''Splinter of the Mind's Eye''''', formerly subtitled '''''From the Further Adventures of Luke Skywalker''''', is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]. It acts as a sequel to [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which Foster wrote the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of, and it was the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' Expanded Universe. The novel was first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[February 12]], [[1978]].

Set in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], ''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'' follows [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], where they seek out the powerful [[Kaiburr crystal]] and encounter [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
